step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home button () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work > Clauses. The list of clauses inserted in the document is displayed.

note.p: You can identify the read-only clauses by a lock icon () displayed corresponding to the clause name. To know more about read-only clauses, see Making Clauses Delete Read-Only. You can identify the alternate clauses by the split arrow icon () displayed corresponding to the clause name. To know more about alternate clauses, see Viewing and Replacing Alternate Clauses.

step.cmd: Click on a clause name in the list. The document scrolls to highlight the selected clause in the template.

postreq.p: A newly marked clause is also displayed in the Clauses list.
